pcs.pc_description: ensure that the litter used in the farm is dry to prevent any infection or disease spread
dispose of the used & old litter regularly especially once a flock is sold or removed as per the instructions
ensure that the feed and water is properly sanitized to prevent any gut infection or disease

monitor the remaining flock extensively once a chick(s) shows advanced signs of disease/infection

ensure that visitors comply with the farm's safety and hygiene norms viz. use of sanitizers, wearing PPE, etc.
ensure the chicks/birds do not come in contact with their droppings or any chemical being used in the premises
rake/stir the litter timely to prevent any infection or disease spread and keep the ammonia levels in check

pcs.pc_description: perform visual inspection of farm tools and equipment daily
check that all tools and equipment like brooder units, chick guards, oven, various kinds of feeders and drinkers etc are in working and usable condition
check that there are no liquid spillages, blockage or cracks in them

report malfunctions or the need for repairs to the farm supervisor

clean the poultry farm and its surrounding area daily

pcs.pc_description: clean the nest box and disinfect it periodically to avoid bad odour
replace the nesting bedding material periodically
ensure to wash hands properly before the collection of eggs
collect the eggs at the recommended intervals from the shed, handling them carefully to avoid damage
ensure the collected eggs are kept in correct position in disinfected egg trays
sort and inspect eggs for quality, removing cracked or abnormal eggs
discard the soiled and floored eggs as per SOP
clean the dirty eggs with emery paper as early as possible
grade the hatching eggs based on various physical parameters such as weight, size, shape, shell thickness, cleanliness on the egg shell, etc
fumigate the hatching eggs with the recommended chemical for the stipulated time
ensure to use the foot dip and hand wash before entering the cool room
store the eggs in the cool room at the recommended temperature and relative humidity percentage

modules.module_title: Pack and transport hatching eggs to the hatchery and table eggs to the market

pcs.pc_description: pack the hatching eggs as per the recommended capacity of the box
follow the FIFO (First In, First out) system
provide enough padding with the packing material to prevent shaking of the egg boxes in transportation
disinfect the vehicle by using hand spray
load the egg boxes into the vehicle by stacking in the recommended numbers
